## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, because its hard-coded default ignores the environment configuration required by project policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` arguments, filters collected files by name, logs skipped files, and adds documentation and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you still archive `.log` files because the default is always `[]`. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment include files they intended to omit. — Fix: Read `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` for the default and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover a configured environment.
